game.name: ASHVALE Atlas
game.description: ASHVALE Atlas 2.0: the whole planet, now drawn from the game's own registry, so every release of the game shows here at once - every village and camp, Ziibiing on the far continent included. The equator and the poles are marked. Tap a spot and Walk here: you stand on the ground at eye height and walk it; Fly up returns you to the air.
